title: USB dry-cabinet environmental logger
engineering: Digital signal model. Distinguish new samples, carried-forward readings, startup without data and expired readings.
physical_check: Compare against a reference humidity instrument and log a real USB disconnect and reconnect.

title: Custom four-wire harness checker
engineering: Digital signal model. Test an exact four-wire cross-harness against every single open, output swap and pairwise bridge.
physical_check: Confirm the exact mating connectors and continuity on an unpowered known-good cable, then test fault plugs.

title: Buffered digital timing capture pod
engineering: Digital signal model. Determine which capture interval can see the shortest specified pulse at every sampled phase.
physical_check: Measure input thresholds, shortest detectable pulse width, interchannel skew and crosstalk on the populated pod.

title: Stepper winding identification and jog station
engineering: Digital signal model. Recover both coil pairs under all lead permutations and reject an open coil and an intercoil bridge.
physical_check: Measure a named four-lead motor and check current-limited slow jog. Five- and six-lead motors need a separate classification.

title: Bench resistance substitution box
engineering: Digital signal model. Compute the tolerance envelope for all 1,000 settings and identify when the two-wire contacts dominate.
physical_check: Measure every switch position at the terminals on a calibrated meter. Repeat low-ohm settings after operating the switches.

title: Four-wire Kelvin clamp fixture
engineering: Digital signal model. Replay ten assumed remounts, comparing separate sense contacts with a sense lead mistakenly sharing the force contact.
physical_check: Remount a reference shunt ten times, reverse the test current to assess offsets and check the separate contact positions.

title: USB hands-free test trigger pedal
engineering: Digital signal model. Inject switch bounce and reconnect while held, requiring a release before a new trigger.
physical_check: Record one event per stroke on the host and unplug and reconnect the USB cable with the pedal depressed.

title: Eight-port selectable I2C sensor breakout
engineering: Digital signal model. Prevent selecting multiple same-address channels and show how combined data can resemble a valid zero.
physical_check: Read two marked same-address sensors on every connector and measure bus signal edges with the intended cable length.

title: Wired director tally lamp
engineering: Digital signal model. Check all contact combinations, transition latency and loss of both closures.
physical_check: Verify dark state on unplug and time 100 mixer-contact transitions including simultaneous program and preview.

title: Four-pad USB MIDI trigger box
engineering: Digital signal model. Replay light and hard strikes with coupled adjacent signals and compare false notes across two thresholds.
physical_check: Measure missed and doubled notes and velocity response from 30 light and hard strikes on each actual pad.

title: Three-pedal stream shortcut controller
engineering: Digital signal model. Exercise simultaneous holds and releases plus 500 strokes per pedal. Compare the reports with a one-key encoder.
physical_check: Run a hold and release log on each supported host. Measure debounce and verify shortcut behavior inside the intended app.

title: Two-switch wired USB interface
engineering: Digital signal model. Replay independent, simultaneous and reconfigured holds, including unplug recovery when a key is still down.
physical_check: Repeat on the two named hosts with the user's actual switches. Verify socket fit, accessibility and release handling.

title: Two-message tactile playback pad
engineering: Digital signal model. Interrupt a replacement message at each write-operation boundary and verify recovery of the prior committed audio payload.
physical_check: Record and recover distinct audio after 20 real power cycles and verify tactile identification with the intended user.

title: Dry-contact switch latch and timer
engineering: Digital signal model. Replay both modes on a discrete clock including a press during an active interval and simulated power loss.
physical_check: Compare each preset with a reference timer for 100 cycles, verify relay release and confirm default open after power loss.

title: Servo characterization dial and load arm
engineering: Digital signal model. Compute the load moment over a servo angle sweep and quantify the error from assuming a horizontal arm.
physical_check: Measure lever length and angle under load, weigh the fixture and test power, holding current and safe servo limits independently.

title: USB-UART service adapter with keyed leads
engineering: Digital signal model. Check alternating and boundary bit patterns across three declared rates and injected clock skew.
physical_check: Loop back on the populated board and measure actual logic voltage in each keyed position. Test supported hosts.

title: Passive stereo monitor level box
engineering: Digital signal model. Bound stereo balance at six settings with finite source and load impedances.
physical_check: Sweep both channels under a named load and measure tracking, residual hum, noise and mute isolation.

title: Headphone rehearsal splitter amplifier
engineering: Digital signal model. Sweep simultaneous dummy loads and reject a source with insufficient per-side peak current.
physical_check: Test both real outputs into declared dummy loads. Measure output limit, distortion, noise and heating; hearing comfort is outside the model.

title: Large single access button
engineering: Digital signal model. Compare center and four edge activation forces for two hinge positions at a fixed switch lever distance.
physical_check: Measure activation force and travel at center and edges, inspect return, and test 500 actuations with the actual mounting and intended user.
